title: Erratum record (registry/errata/<configuration>/ERR-NNN.yaml)
description: The effect of one defect on one registered configuration (a SoC release or a silicon revision): forms present, exposure and how it was established, category, conditions, workaround, status and errata-document revision. Owner: registry loader. F1, F2, F3, F4.

configuration.description: F1: exactly one configuration from registry/eligibility.yaml.

forms_present.description: F1: ids of the defect's forms present in this configuration.

exposure.description: F2: how exposure was established. Only a detector run on the configuration's built output (generated RTL or netlist) can prove `exposed`, `affected` or `not-affected`; ancestry or reading the source gives at most `probably-exposed` (amber).

detector.description: Id of the detector in the defect record.

evidence.description: What was checked, where, and the result, in one line. For a detector: the input (archive, netlist) and its md5.

category.description: F1: A, B or C (Arm SDEN style); null while undecided.

conditions.description: F1: what must hold in this configuration for the defect to bite.

merged.description: Reachable from the component's default branch when last checked.

status.description: F1. `permanent` is for silicon configurations only (checked by the loader).

doc_revision.description: F1, F4: the revision of this configuration's errata document in which this record last changed.
